entities.summary: Lombard Kingdom, a political institution in Italy during Early Medieval Italy (774–1000). Grew from Lombard and Ostrogoths, Byzantines, and Lombards. Led to the emergence of Carolingian Italy and Fragmentation and Charlemagne.
